IdColumnDropper.source:
import re
from typing import List, Optional
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.base import TransformerMixin

from factory.operators.base import Operator, OperatorMeta
from factory.schemas import OperatorKind


class IdColumnDropper(TransformerMixin, Operator):
    meta = OperatorMeta(
        name="IdColumnDropper",
        kind=OperatorKind.FEATURE,
        version=2,
        origin="synthesized",
        description="剔除客户ID等标识列以防止特征维度暴涨与过拟合",
        conditions=["id_columns"],
        dependencies=[],
        params={
            "columns": None,
            "auto_detect": True,
            "pattern": r"(?i)(?:^|_)(?:id|uuid|guid|code|no)(?:$|_)|^customer_id$|^user_id$",
            "high_cardinality_threshold": 0.98,
        },
    )

    def __init__(
        self,
        columns: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        auto_detect: bool = True,
        pattern: str = r"(?i)(?:^|_)(?:id|uuid|guid|code|no)(?:$|_)|^customer_id$|^user_id$",
        high_cardinality_threshold: float = 0.98,
    ):
        self.columns = columns
        self.auto_detect = auto_detect
        self.pattern = pattern
        self.high_cardinality_threshold = high_cardinality_threshold

    def fit(self, X: pd.DataFrame, y=None):
        cols_to_drop = set()

        if self.columns:
            for col in self.columns:
                if col in X.columns:
                    cols_to_drop.add(col)

        if self.auto_detect and len(X) > 0:
            regex = re.compile(self.pattern)
            for col in X.columns:
                col_str = str(col)
                # 检查列名是否匹配 ID 命名模式
                is_name_match = bool(regex.search(col_str))

                # 计算非空值的唯一值比例
                non_null_series = X[col].dropna()
                n_count = len(non_null_series)
                ratio = (non_null_series.nunique() / n_count) if n_count > 0 else 0.0

                # 若命中了名称规则，或者属于高基数字符串/对象标识列且唯一率极高
                if is_name_match:
                    cols_to_drop.add(col)
                elif pd.api.types.is_object_dtype(X[col]) or pd.api.types.is_string_dtype(X[col]):
                    if ratio >= self.high_cardinality_threshold and n_count > 30:
                        # 辅以简单判断，避免误删长文本描述（均长较短更可能是标识符）
                        avg_len = non_null_series.astype(str).str.len().mean()
                        if avg_len <= 64:
                            cols_to_drop.add(col)

        self.dropped_columns_ = sorted(list(cols_to_drop))
        return self

    def transform(self, X: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        X = X.copy()
        if hasattr(self, "dropped_columns_") and self.dropped_columns_:
            existing_cols = [c for c in self.dropped_columns_ if c in X.columns]
            if existing_cols:
                X = X.drop(columns=existing_cols)
        return X

from factory.operators.base import Operator, OperatorMeta
from factory.schemas import OperatorKind, Modality
from sklearn.base import ClassifierMixin
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import lightgbm as lgb


class BalancedLightGBMClassifier(ClassifierMixin, Operator):
    meta = OperatorMeta(
        name="BalancedLightGBMClassifier",
        kind=OperatorKind.MODEL,
        version=2,
        origin="synthesized",
        description="基于LightGBM的平衡二分类模型，通过样本类别加权提升不平衡数据下的召回率并提供特征重要性",
        conditions=["imbalanced", "classification", "tabular"],
        dependencies=["lightgbm", "numpy", "pandas", "scikit-learn"],
        params={
            "n_estimators": 400,
            "learning_rate": 0.05,
            "num_leaves": 31,
            "max_depth": -1,
            "min_child_samples": 20,
            "subsample": 1.0,
            "colsample_bytree": 1.0,
            "reg_alpha": 0.0,
            "reg_lambda": 0.0,
            "class_weight": "balanced",
            "random_state": 42,
            "n_jobs": -1,
            "verbose": -1,
        },
        parent="BalancedLightGBMClassifier@1",
    )

    def __init__(
        self,
        n_estimators: int = 400,
        learning_rate: float = 0.05,
        num_leaves: int = 31,
        max_depth: int = -1,
        min_child_samples: int = 20,
        subsample: float = 1.0,
        colsample_bytree: float = 1.0,
        reg_alpha: float = 0.0,
        reg_lambda: float = 0.0,
        class_weight: str = "balanced",
        random_state: int = 42,
        n_jobs: int = -1,
        verbose: int = -1,
    ):
        self.n_estimators = n_estimators
        self.learning_rate = learning_rate
        self.num_leaves = num_leaves
        self.max_depth = max_depth
        self.min_child_samples = min_child_samples
        self.subsample = subsample
        self.colsample_bytree = colsample_bytree
        self.reg_alpha = reg_alpha
        self.reg_lambda = reg_lambda
        self.class_weight = class_weight
        self.random_state = random_state
        self.n_jobs = n_jobs
        self.verbose = verbose

    def _prepare_data(self, X: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        X_out = X.copy()
        for col in X_out.columns:
            if X_out[col].dtype == "object":
                X_out[col] = X_out[col].astype("category")
        return X_out

    def fit(self, X: pd.DataFrame, y: pd.Series):
        X_proc = self._prepare_data(X)
        y_proc = np.asarray(y)

        self.feature_names_in_ = np.array(X_proc.columns, dtype=str)
        self.n_features_in_ = X_proc.shape[1]

        self.model_ = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
            n_estimators=self.n_estimators,
            learning_rate=self.learning_rate,
            num_leaves=self.num_leaves,
            max_depth=self.max_depth,
            min_child_samples=self.min_child_samples,
            subsample=self.subsample,
            colsample_bytree=self.colsample_bytree,
            reg_alpha=self.reg_alpha,
            reg_lambda=self.reg_lambda,
            class_weight=self.class_weight,
            random_state=self.random_state,
            n_jobs=self.n_jobs,
            verbose=self.verbose,
        )
        self.model_.fit(X_proc, y_proc)

        self.classes_ = np.asarray(self.model_.classes_)
        self.feature_importances_ = np.asarray(self.model_.feature_importances_)
        return self

    def predict_proba(self, X: pd.DataFrame) -> np.ndarray:
        X_proc = self._prepare_data(X)
        proba = self.model_.predict_proba(X_proc)
        return np.asarray(proba, dtype=np.float64)

    def predict(self, X: pd.DataFrame) -> np.ndarray:
        X_proc = self._prepare_data(X)
        preds = self.model_.predict(X_proc)
        return np.asarray(preds)

lessons.trigger: 新入网客户累计消费为空白字符串，读取为 object 类型，转 float 时抛出 ValueError: could not convert string to float: ' '
lessons.fix: 先 str.strip()，再 pd.to_numeric(errors='coerce')，缺失值填补为 0

lessons.title: 样本不平衡导致默认模型召回率偏低

lessons.title: 逻辑回归标准化与可解释性
lessons.trigger: 使用逻辑回归模型，或者需要模型具有高可解释性时
lessons.fix: 必须先进行特征标准化（如 StandardFeatureScaler），在 0.1~10 之间搜索正则化强度 C，可直接输出系数给业务方。

lessons.title: 未剔除客户 ID 导致 One-Hot 编码后维度暴涨与内存溢出

lessons.title: 避免在沙箱中使用 getattr 等受限反射函数，访问可选属性应使用 try/except AttributeError
lessons.trigger: 静态安全检查拦截（E_UNSAFE），提示“禁止调用 getattr()”或其它沙箱禁用的内置函数
lessons.fix: 避免使用 getattr、setattr 等受限反射函数；获取可能未初始化的属性时，改用直接属性访问并配合 try/except AttributeError 来提供默认值
